notes.title: Free Koala
notes.content: I'm the Koala is now free to play!

notes.title: Control Improvements - Patch 1.1
notes.content: New controls have been added into the game. In addition to the left and right arrow controls, players can now use the 'a' and 'd' key to navigate the player left and right. The 'w' key can now also be used to make the koala jump. All of the previous controls are still in the game.
